== English errata comparison sources ==
any Imperial → an Imperial in the power clause. The Plastoid Armor replacement specifies that for remainder of game it is an Effect and is not unique. Alter immunity explicitly applies while on table. The Rebel or alien must be at the same mobile site as Elom. The character is now 'disguised', replacing the previous as if 'stolen' wording.

No matching Decipher Glossary 2.0 or Supplement replacement. The PC slip sheet attests the current state by 1 January 2013, more specific than the current by 2023 Released field. A D-E1 reconstruction footer does not override the source attribution. Preserve the other exact unchanged clauses and face provenance.
